tasks.title: Reproduce reference baseline on this machine
tasks.instructions: Create the venv OUTSIDE the repo (e.g. %LOCALAPPDATA%\ops-ref-venv) and install the reference web+test extras WITHOUT -e; run the 58 tests and the recovery CLI on Windows; save outputs under reports/baseline/. Do not modify reference code.
definition_of_done: 58-test result and CLI output saved with exact commands and environment.
Failures recorded verbatim; nothing skipped or edited to pass.
Venv path recorded and outside the repo; `git status` clean apart from reports/baseline/.

tasks.title: Owner authors and seals holdout intents
tasks.instructions: Define evals/holdout-case.schema.json. Owner writes ~25 case intents/requests without AI assistance, stores them off-machine or encrypted, commits only sha256 + count, and records the hash outside the local repo (push or dated email to self) before T02 starts. Gold labels come later in T41. Also record externally, with the holdout hash, the sha256 of handoff/prompts/incident-draft-v1.md and schema-repair-v1.md (the probe's unchanged prompts).
definition_of_done: evals/holdout-case.schema.json and evals/holdout.sha256 committed; hash also recorded externally with date.
No holdout content in the repo or agent-readable paths.
Recorded before T02 (probe) and T19 (prompts) begin.

tasks.title: Environment inventory and qwen3:8b probe
tasks.instructions: Per AM-31: author >=30 distinct probe inputs under evals/probe/, each with a small synthetic evidence bundle (not dev seeds, not holdout); use handoff/prompts/incident-draft-v1.md and schema-repair-v1.md unchanged at their recorded hashes; validate against 1.0 model-draft.schema.json; run via `uv run --isolated --no-project --with langchain-ollama==1.1.0` and save the freeze via importlib.metadata; reasoning=False, num_ctx=16384; first-pass and post-repair validity with Wilson CIs; identical-repeat rate at temperature 0; cold-start vs warm latency; VRAM; thinking leakage; mid-generation cancellation via `ollama ps`/GPU. Measurement, not tuning.
definition_of_done: reports/model-probe-qwen3-8b.md with measured rates, denominators, CIs, digest and parameters.
Cancellation behaviour measured and the model_permit release rule chosen accordingly.
Owner decision on proceeding recorded.

tasks.title: uv workspace with per-service directories and locks
tasks.instructions: ADR-0001 layout (core/, api/, worker/, mcp-server/, asset-sim/, incident-sim/). Move the whole reference unit unchanged into reference/ (src, tests, pyproject, Makefile, Dockerfile, compose, integrations, scripts/init_demo.py, scripts/check_reference.sh), excluded from the uv workspace and from root ruff/mypy/pytest with provenance/reference-code-hashes.remap.json and checker support; root pyproject becomes the uv workspace root. Create data/seed-ids.json (tenant/persona UUIDs). Resolve versions per AM-30, commit uv.lock, add jsonschema to the dev group; checker skips .venv*/node_modules. ruff, mypy, pytest via one Python entry point (`uv run python scripts/check.py`; no make on this machine). Re-create the reference venv from reference/ and re-run its suite.
definition_of_done: `uv sync --locked` succeeds from a clean clone.
`verify_handoff.py --reference-code` passes via the remap, and the reference suite passes again from reference/ in its external venv.
One command runs ruff + mypy + pytest green; data/seed-ids.json committed.
Each service README states ownership and trust boundary.

tasks.title: Dev bootstrap: Compose dev profile, Keycloak realm, secrets, seed IDs
tasks.instructions: Compose dev profile with PostgreSQL+pgvector and Keycloak 26.8.x (pinned digest); fixed KC_HOSTNAME so iss matches for host and container callers; documented dev topology (which processes run in containers vs host); realm export with 5 personas (UUIDs from data/seed-ids.json), workload clients and hardcoded-audience mappers (MCP_RESOURCE_URL parameter, incident-sim); view-users service account; Windows-friendly secret generation outside git; host Ollama bridge.
definition_of_done: One command brings up the dev profile from a clean clone on Windows.
Tokens for each workload client carry the expected aud and azp; user tokens' sub equals the Keycloak user ID (asserted).
No secret committed; generated secrets live in an ignored file.

tasks.title: Early secret-free CI
tasks.instructions: GitHub Actions workflow for ruff, mypy and unit tests with pinned action SHAs and read-only token; requires the public repo to exist.
definition_of_done: CI runs on push and PR in jschnepel/MLOps and is green.
No secrets or privileged contexts used.
review_notes: Requires a public repo at M01 while publication approval sits at T34 - owner decides: approve early publication or start private and flip public at T34.

ESCALATED, ABANDONED_UNVERIFIED and the slot rule; apply every AM-80 schema/example/fixture change incl. new schemas and error codes; update verify_handoff.py (renamed field, tools/ and evals/ schemas, skip dirs); port the pure-core reference tests and write reference/TRACEABILITY.md mapping all 58 to port/replace/drop. Every allowed transition tested; disallowed ones rejected; revision from BLOCKED_REVIEW needs a free slot.
reference/TRACEABILITY.md covers all 58 tests with an owning task for each replacement.
Every AM-80 negative example fails for its stated reason; no  in governed text files.

tasks.title: Walking skeleton: api, worker, mcp-server, incident-sim
tasks.instructions: Fake model; PostgreSQL and Keycloak from T05; processes api, worker, mcp-server, incident-sim. Real client-credentials tokens from T05 (no shared secrets). POST run -> job -> worker -> mcp-server create_incident -> incident-sim -> receipt -> event. Schema is Alembic revision 1 (extended by T09); incident-sim code is the base T10 extends.
definition_of_done: One e2e test drives a run to SUCCEEDED across the four processes with real tokens.
Skeleton shortcuts listed in SESSION_STATE.md as debt with owning tasks; no throwaway auth.
Schema created as Alembic revision 1 (owner role; T09 re-owns and enables RLS in later revisions).

tasks.title: Migrations, roles, RLS and hardened definer functions
tasks.instructions: Alembic schema (incl. run_lease, runs.next_event_seq, runs.checkpoint_id, execution_grant.run_id UNIQUE, action_attempt, sessions); roles per AM-02; FORCE RLS; app_definer-owned SECURITY DEFINER functions with fixed search_path and REVOKE FROM PUBLIC; app.current_time().
definition_of_done: Migrations up/down on real PostgreSQL.
mcp_exec cannot SELECT any table; definer path cannot cross tenants.
Pooled connections do not leak tenant context.
review_notes: RLS bootstrap: RLS-free run_directory(run_id, tenant_id) + invocation_context readable only by app_definer/sweeper; named cross-tenant sweeper policy for expire_proposals, membership sync, session lookup.
Definer functions declare SET app.tenant_id='' as an attribute; test that a preset tenant from mcp_exec is ignored.
app.current_time() test offset gated by PROFILE=test.

tasks.title: incident-sim destination with action_key table
tasks.instructions: Single action_key table; INSERT .. ON CONFLICT for incidents and abort; recomputed hash; never-expiring keys; incident-sim audience auth; test-only fault factory.
definition_of_done: Concurrent same-key POSTs and POST-vs-abort races yield exactly one terminal key state.
Different hash under an existing key returns CONFLICT; worker/API tokens get 403.
review_notes: Destination at READ COMMITTED; keep GET /internal/actions/{id}; abort stores grant hash; POST onto ABORTED returns tombstone regardless of hash (late-POST fault test).
Fault factory lives in shared core.testing.faults (R098 co-owned with T13).

tasks.title: Keycloak login, server-side sessions and revocation
tasks.instructions: authlib code+PKCE with state in the server-side session store; opaque hashed session IDs; CSRF and origin checks; hand-written back-channel logout endpoint; admin-API enabled check on decision-class mutations; 60 s membership sync.
definition_of_done: Negative tests for state/nonce/iss/aud, CSRF, revoked membership.
Disabled user: next decision-class mutation 401; grants blocked within 60 s.
Back-channel logout token validation incl. jti replay.
review_notes: Admin-API check: 2 s timeout, cached service-account token, fail closed 503 retryable when Keycloak is down/slow. The 'grants blocked <=60 s' half of R086 is verified in T21.

tasks.title: Durable admission API and error mapping
tasks.instructions: /api/v1 conversations/messages/runs; message+run+job+event committed before 202; scoped Idempotency-Key (24 h); one active run per conversation; interval resolved once; safe error schema and 401/403/404/409/422/429/503 mapping.
definition_of_done: Crash-before-commit leaves no ack; after commit the job exists.
Replay same body returns same result; different body 409.
Each status code has a test proving the mapping.

tasks.title: Run lease, fence locking, heartbeat thread and fault factory
tasks.instructions: Lease acquisition FOR UPDATE; fenced writes FOR SHARE; clock_timestamp via app.current_time(); published lock order; heartbeat on its own thread/connection; local monotonic deadline; model_permit with SKIP LOCKED; test-only fault factory for app services.
definition_of_done: Two-connection interleaving test: stale fence write aborts.
Stress test shows no deadlock under the lock order.
Blocked event loop (25 s) does not lose the lease; forced renewal failure cancels work.
review_notes: Transactions that write run_lease take FOR UPDATE from the start (no FOR SHARE upgrade).
Owner re-fence path hands the new fence to the heartbeat thread atomically.
Lock order includes the asset-guard advisory lock and memberships (AM-12); also place jobs, invocation_context, model_permit, sessions.
Gate heartbeat renewal on event-loop liveness and the 90 s compute budget.

tasks.title: Gap-free event journal, wake-ups and outbox
tasks.instructions: runs.next_event_seq under the runs lock; wake-up jobs committed with user events; sweeper; transactional outbox with leased delivery loop (no external channel).
definition_of_done: Concurrent writers yield gap-free commit-ordered sequences.
Outbox rows deduplicated and leased; delivery result recorded separately.

tasks.title: Authenticated MCP server, token verifier and invocation handles

definition_of_done: Independent-process client lists and calls tools.
Missing/wrong aud, browser token, replayed/expired/other-run/other-azp handle all rejected.
Protocol-version header/_meta mismatch rejected.
review_notes: status=error-only-before-grant applies to authorized callers; auth failures never reveal action_id.
Allowlist checks attempt state (create_incident only with no attempt or INTENT, not cancelled, before deadline).

tasks.title: LangGraph workflow with sync durability and stored checkpoint IDs
tasks.instructions: Nodes per BUILD_SPEC section 8; retrieval before drafting; durability=sync; runs.checkpoint_id stored under fence and used on resume; idempotent pre-interrupt logic; ID-only interrupts; human waits release the lease; ANSWERED path.

Pause/resume survives worker restart from the stored checkpoint_id; a newer stray head is ignored.
Checkpoint blobs contain no evidence or proposal text.
review_notes: LangGraph 1.2.14: explicit checkpoint_id => is_replaying, pending writes NOT re-applied (_loop.py:330, 766-770); Command(resume) keeps RESUME writes; invoke(None, checkpoint_id) forks (886-912). Store IDs from stream_mode='checkpoints'/aget_state, update after forks, make every node idempotent, test kill-mid-superstep and kill-at-interrupt, join stale in-process tasks before re-acquiring.

tasks.title: Proposals, decisions, manual proposals, feedback and final grant
tasks.instructions: Per-revision proposal IDs; expected_payload_sha256; first decision wins; author-set independence; expiry to BLOCKED_REVIEW; manual-proposal API; feedback endpoint; grant_execution final gate with UNIQUE(run_id), proposal/run binding, asset freshness and asset guard.
definition_of_done: Self-approval and reviewer-authored-revision approval denied; opposing/stale decisions 409.
Revocation or cancellation before grant blocks dispatch; a second grant for a run is impossible.
Lost-wakeup crash between decision commit and processing recovered by the sweeper.
review_notes: Asset guard via pg_advisory_xact_lock(tenant, asset) first in lock order; refusal 409 ASSET_ACTION_UNRESOLVED.
Revision from BLOCKED_REVIEW requires a free conversation slot (SLOT_OCCUPIED 409).
Verify R086's grant-blocking half (membership sync <=60 s).

tasks.title: Attempt protocol, recovery, abort and escalation
tasks.instructions: grant inserts INTENT; mark_sent before I/O; record_outcome; recover jobs with redispatch/abort rules; reconciliation backoff; transport-timeout rule; CONFLICT and deadlines to ESCALATED; asset guard; receipt retention.
definition_of_done: Kill tests at INTENT, SENT, post-commit and pre-persist each end with one matching incident or an authoritative abort.
Timeout during create_incident resolves via the lease-lock read.
Hash conflict escalates; never success; escalated action blocks a duplicate for the same asset/interval.
review_notes: Redispatch skips the section 13 gate via lookup_action -> mark_sent; mark_sent re-checks cancel/deadline under runs lock.
Cancellation after SENT aborts immediately; otherwise abort at dispatch deadline (<=5 min FAILED latency stated).
Operator CLI `ops resolve-escalation` -> ABANDONED_UNVERIFIED with operator_resolutions audit row.
Late destination evidence on ABANDONED_UNVERIFIED emits action.late_evidence; record_outcome never transitions terminal runs; recover jobs stay allowed.
